 Prime Video series filmed in South Wales called an 'absolute gem' with 'zero boring episodes': Can you guess the show?
 SECTIONS Prime Video series filmed in South Wales called an 'absolute gem' with 'zero boring episodes': Can you guess the show? ET Online Last Updated: Nov 01, 2026, 09:00:00 PM IST Rate Story Follow us Share Font Size Abc Small Abc Medium Abc Large Save Print Comment Synopsis Young Sherlock presents a captivating look into the life of Sherlock Holmes as he delves into a murder case at Oxford University. This series not only unravels his investigative skills but also showcases his intricate early ties with the notorious James Moriarty. With Guy Ritchie at the helm for the first episodes, filming spanned picturesque locations in South Wales, providing an authentic backdrop for the narrative.
 Image courtesy: Young Sherlock/ Prime Video/ YouTube Murder at Oxford University drags a young Sherlock Holmes into a world of secrets, danger and unlikely friendships. Guy Ritchie's Young Sherlock has gained viewer attention, with one TV expert calling it a series with “zero boring episodes”. The eight-part show on Prime Video also has a South Wales link, with some of the scenes filmed there. The series explores the early life of Sherlock Holmes before he becomes the renowned detective known for solving some of the world’s most challenging cases. Recently, it has garnered attention after TV expert Anubhuti Navin, who manages The Watchlist Club, recommended the show.
 What Is Young Sherlock About?
The series features Hero Fiennes Tiffin as a 19-year-old Sherlock Holmes, whose life unexpectedly changes when he becomes involved in a murder investigation at Oxford University. During this investigation, Sherlock Holmes encounters James Moriarty, portrayed by Dónal Finn. While Moriarty eventually becomes his greatest adversary, the show explores the early stages of their relationship.
 The cast also features Zine Tseng as Xiao Wei, Joseph Fiennes as Sherlock’s father, Silas, and Colin Firth as Sir Bucephalus Hodge. The story draws inspiration from the novels written by Andy Lane, which focus on Holmes’ early years, and is based on the original Sherlock Holmes stories by Sir Arthur Conan Doyle. Navin described the show as a ‘must-watch’ and ‘an absolute gem.’ She also noted that it is “one of the best series with no boring episodes.” Her review was featured in The Mirror and WalesOnline. 
 Where Was Young Sherlock Filmed In Wales?
Llandaff Cathedral in Cardiff, Monmouth, Bridgend, and Margam Park near Port Talbot are just a few of the South Wales locations where the series was filmed. Filming also happened in Spain and Bristol. The show's period setting is effectively enhanced by these Welsh locations. Ritchie's fast-paced writing style adds to the series' overall plot, which blends elements of mystery, action, and drama.
 Guy Ritchie Returns To Sherlock Holmes
Guy Ritchie is best known for films like Snatch and Lock, Stock and Two Smoking Barrels. He also directed the 2009 film Sherlock Holmes and its 2011 sequel, starring Robert Downey Jr. and Jude Law. Ritchie directed the first two episodes of Young Sherlock and assisted in developing the series. Reports say the show has received positive reviews on Rotten Tomatoes, with critics giving it an 84% and audiences an 83%.
 When Will Young Sherlock Season 2 Release?
Prime Video has confirmed a second season of Young Sherlock, which is expected to arrive in 2027. The next season will star Aidan Gillen and Indira Varma, both known for their work on Game of Thrones. Also expected to be part of the cast are Olivia Williams (“The Crown”) and Sophie Skelton (“Outlander”). A new season is coming up, and the series will continue exploring the early years of Sherlock Holmes and the events that led to him becoming the detective we all know and love.
